data.name: ApplicationNameInvalid
data.value: Application name is invalid. Use an RFC1123 label containing 1-63 lowercase letters, numbers, or '-' characters, beginning and ending with a letter or number.

data.name: ApplicationNameRequired
data.value: An RFC1123 application name is required. Pass it to Application.CreateBuilder(ApplicationName, args) or call UseName(...) before Build(); only unnamed Local builders use the entry-assembly fallback.

data.name: ApplicationCredentialSchemeInvalid
data.value: The application credential scheme must be a nonempty HTTP authentication token.

data.name: ApplicationCredentialValueInvalid
data.value: The application credential value must be nonblank and contain no carriage return or line feed.

data.name: ResourceHttpPathInvalid
data.value: A resource HTTP path must begin with '/' and contain no query or fragment.

data.name: ResourceMountSourceInvalid
data.value: A mount source must use parameter:<name>, literal:<value>, or <source>:<key>, with nonblank names and keys.

data.name: LiteralMountKindInvalid
data.value: Mount '{0}' uses literal:, which is allowed only for Configuration mounts.

data.name: ProviderMountSourceInvalid
data.value: Resource '{0}' mount '{1}' source must use parameter:<name>, literal:<value>, or <source>:<key>.

data.name: ApplicationNameJsonString
data.value: An application name must be a JSON string.
